The '''Morath Nebula''' was a volume of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] located in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Galactic Core]], in the [[Hatawa sector/Legends|Hatawa sector]]. In [[17 ABY/Legends|17 ABY]], it had still not been fully explored, and was thus considered as a possible hiding-place for the [[Black Fleet]].

==Behind the scenes==
The ''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' states the Morath Nebula is in either the Farlax or Kokash sectors.
